notes: The opt-in ground-plate preview now keeps each seam's cavity footprint continuous where three plate regions meet, instead of letting the groove jump when two neighbouring plates exchange identity.
The same junction treatment reaches the cave-to-ground contact band, preserves the plates-off crawl floor exactly, and holds the measured six-metre relief read above its previous level.

Still short of the mark: the ground remains an arithmetic material without Fatekeeper's physical texture character, the plate field still lacks authored fracture patterns and wear, and WAR_GROUND_PLATES stays off by default pending art review.
title: Plate seams hold together at junctions
